prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in steps (sign_in, reorder) proved helpful (+3.0% average after noise correction), winning 3 tests, while 3 showed no clear effect and 1 was stopped early.
Home redesigns (home, redesign) showed no clear effect across 2 tests (-3.3% average after noise correction).
Choose path redesigns (choose_path, redesign) were helpful (+2.9% average after noise correction), winning 1 test while 1 showed no clear effect.
Adoption new flows (adoption, new_flow) showed mixed results (+0.9% average after noise correction), winning 1 test, showing no clear effect in 1, and performing poorly in 1.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_screen, adoption redesign, finish new_screen, and sign_in redesign, as only 1 test has been completed for each.
Predictions were generally too low for winning tests and too high for tests showing no clear effect or performing poorly.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +0.9% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: +7.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -8.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +2.9% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -7.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: -3.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.0% after noise correction, 7 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.6%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 85.6%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 75.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 27.3%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Interactive compact layout for home welcome step: Redesign the home_intro screen using a compact layout with an interactive control preview component. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% with long median/mean duration (395s/5815s) and users write support emails about post-onboarding desktop controls confusion.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop setup guidance on waiting screen: Add visible progress status and desktop visibility instructions to the pet generation waiting screen. (why: Users wait a median of 201s during pet generation and 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on desktop after waiting.)
2: [sign_in, redesign] List layout sign-in screen redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen into a structured list layout clearly distinguishing existing account login from guest registration. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in with wrong or duplicate accounts.)
3: [adoption, redesign] Two-column layout for pick friend screen: Rebuild the pick_friend screen with a two-column layout comparing preset pets next to custom photo creation options. (why: Adoption has a low conversion (75.2%) and long mean time (1017s); side-by-side choices help users decide faster.)
4: [finish, hint] Desktop tray and hotkey control hint: Display explicit hotkey and system tray control hints on the home_intro screen. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the desktop pet after finishing onboarding.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Clear path comparison copy on story screen: Update story screen headline and body text to set distinct expectations between instant pet selection and photo generation. (why: Choose_path has a 80.6% drop-off step conversion and high mean duration (514s) due to unclear choice expectations.)
6: [home, notification] Ready notification trigger on waiting step: Enable desktop notification prompts on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app during pet generation. (why: Generation waiting time has high mean duration (2336s), causing users to close or abandon the app while waiting.)

scores.note: Finish step has highest drop-off and support complaints, but major UI redesigns have consistently shown poor results.
Addresses high waiting duration and support emails with informative status guidance.
Strong support email backing, but previous sign_in redesign had a slightly negative impact.
Adoption has high drop-off, but prior adoption redesign test resulted in -8.1% lift.
Targets lowest converting finish step with hints to resolve reported post-onboarding confusion.
Low cost copy tweak targeting choose_path where previous path changes averaged +2.9% lift.
Notification trigger mitigates user drop-off during the long home step wait time.
